item.title: Hutíes vs. Arabia Saudita: cómo la guerra entre Irán y Estados Unidos reaviva el conflicto de Yemen
item.description: En Yemen, la escalada de violencia de los hutíes contra las fuerzas gubernamentales se ha extendido a la vecina Arabia Saudita, que también es blanco de los rebeldes chiítas. Los combates han dejado más de 500 muertos desde el jueves 3 de septiembre, rompiendo el alto el fuego vigente desde 2022. El objetivo de los hutíes es controlar el estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb, un paso estratégico a la entrada del mar Rojo, mientras que el estrecho de Ormuz ya está bloqueado por su aliado iraní. item.title: Antarctica gained 695 billion tons in 2021-23 as tropical warmth drove heavy snowfall
item.description: Between 2021 and 2023, Antarctica experienced a notable gain in ice mass, primarily driven by exceptional snowfall in East Antarctica. This unusual occurrence, influenced by warmer tropical ocean temperatures, caused atmospheric disturbances that transported moisture southward. Although this gain temporarily countered ongoing ice loss in other regions, it does not signify a change in Antarctica's long-term trend of declining ice mass. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

The one-kilometre bridge spans the Tumen River between Khasan in Russia’s far east and Tumangang in North Korea, along a remote and sparsely populated stretch of the countries’ shared border just a few miles from the coast. item.title: US war on Iran: 'Incompetent administration when it comes to negotiations and prosecuting war'
item.description: Mark Owen is pleased to welcome Barbara Slavin, Distinguished Fellow at the Simpson Center. She frames the war in the Persian Gulf as a mutually damaging stalemate in which neither Washington nor Tehran has found a politically sustainable exit: "There are no winners in this war". Her central argument is that the conflict has created a problem of face-saving as much as military strategy. The US faces rising economic and electoral costs, while Iran confronts shortages, inflation, domestic dissent and intensified repression. Neither side, in her assessment, can plausibly claim success. Fuente: France 24 - English.
